# Fetch each playlist's songs

spotify_access_token = spotify_token['access_token']

playlist_songs = {}  # playlist_id -> song list from show_playlist
all_song_ids = set()

for p in all_playlists:
    pl_id = p['playlist_id']
    pl_detail = apis.spotify.show_playlist(playlist_id=pl_id, access_token=spotify_access_token)
    songs = pl_detail.get('songs', [])
    playlist_songs[pl_id] = songs
    for s in songs:
        all_song_ids.add(s['id'] if 'id' in s else s.get('song_id'))
    print('playlist', pl_id, 'title', pl_detail.get('title'), 'songs', len(songs))

print('unique_song_ids', len(all_song_ids))
print('sample_song_ids', sorted(list(all_song_ids))[:20])

# <playbook_cite>Following entry [action_subset_filtering_procedure]: resolving filter criteria first, then acting</playbook_cite>

spotify_access_token = spotify_token['access_token']

# Fetch show_song details for each unique song id
song_genre = {}
song_artists = {}  # song_id -> list of {id,name}

# song_ids are in sample list; but we have all_song_ids
all_song_ids_list = sorted(list(all_song_ids))
print('unique_song_ids_total', len(all_song_ids_list))

for idx, sid in enumerate(all_song_ids_list):
    s = apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
    # show_song schema includes genre and artists
    genre = s.get('genre')
    song_genre[sid] = genre
    song_artists[sid] = [{'id': a['id'], 'name': a['name']} for a in s.get('artists', [])]
    if idx < 5:
        print('song', sid, 'title?', s.get('title'), 'genre', genre, 'artists', [a['name'] for a in s.get('artists', [])])

# Determine reggae songs
reggae_song_ids = [sid for sid, g in song_genre.items() if g is not None and 'reggae' in str(g).lower()]
print('reggae_song_ids_count', len(reggae_song_ids))
print('reggae_song_ids_sample', sorted(reggae_song_ids)[:20])

# Count songs per genre for insight
from collections import Counter
c = Counter([str(g).lower() for g in song_genre.values() if g is not None])
print('top_genres', c.most_common(10))
